title: The Weekly Challenge - 393
task1_desc: You are given a positive integer n. Find the number of all positive integer triplets (a, b, c) so that a^2 + b^2 = c^2 and a, b and c are integers <= n.
task2_desc: You are given a string with English alphabetic characters only. What is the absolute difference of the sum of the ASCII values of the characters in the string to the nearest prime number?
